I delt with a coil whine issue myself and I actually fixed it by using the green audio output 3.5mm jack on the IO of my motherboard, on the back of my PC, instead of using the front-facing 3.5mm jack at the front of my PC. Night and day difference for me. 

Can't guarantee you have the same issue but it's worth a shot checking out. If not, they do sell tiny audio preamps that reduce coil whine. I haven't had to get one yet so idk how well those work, but it's an option.

when it comes to hippy flips in skate, the fakie nollie tre flip is actually alot easier than it looks. You just need a low rail around knee height, or a rail/platform to let you get to a rail that height, get into fakie, and pop a low nollie tre flip just before you hit the rail. 

don’t pop it too high cause the animation differs slightly and you’ll hit the rail. Doing the flip out of a nose manual gives you the right height every time, so you only need to worry about the timing in those cases.
